tools.name: get_setup_manual
tools.description: How to install or run a GitHub repository: whether it works on macOS, Windows or Linux (with reasons), ready-made downloads, install commands from the README, the parts it needs, and step-by-step commands to set it up from source. Facts come from the repo's own files, not guesses.

tools.name: get_setup_script
tools.description: One script that sets the repo up on the given system: bash for macOS and Linux, PowerShell for Windows. It stops at the first error, skips what's already installed and never starts servers. Show it to the user to read before running it.

tools.name: search_repos
tools.description: Find open-source GitHub repos on gitmanual's shelf: by words in the name or description, by the system they run on, language or difficulty, or only those rising on GitHub this week. Each result links to its setup manual.

tools.name: get_list
tools.description: gitmanual's lists group repos by what they do and where they run, e.g. self-hosted apps for Linux, AI tools for Windows, MCP servers for macOS. Leave out slug to see every list.

tools.name: find_alternatives
tools.description: When a repo doesn't run (or only partly runs) on the user's system: whether it does, and up to five similar repos that do, judged by shared GitHub topics.
